caption: The drawing depicts a wooden four-poster bed positioned centrally against a plain, light-colored background. The bed has intricately carved spiral posts at each corner, made of brown wood. It is covered with a textured, light-colored, possibly white or off-white, bedspread that drapes slightly over the sides. Part of a wooden headboard is visible at the back, matching the color and style of the bedposts. There are no additional objects or backgrounds, and the artist's signature, "Arthur E. Reynolds," appears below the bed near the bottom center of the drawing. The overall composition is minimalist, with the bed being the sole object in the image.
title: Bed, Four Poster
